$dir = "$env:TEMP\netaws-audit"
function Load-J($n) { Get-Content (Join-Path $dir $n) -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json }

$vpcs = (Load-J 'vpcs.json').Vpcs
$subnets = (Load-J 'subnets.json').Subnets
$nats = (Load-J 'nats.json').NatGateways
$eips = (Load-J 'eips.json').Addresses
$eps = (Load-J 'endpoints.json').VpcEndpoints
$enis = (Load-J 'enis.json').NetworkInterfaces
$igws = (Load-J 'igws.json').InternetGateways
$tgws = (Load-J 'tgws.json').TransitGateways
$tgwa = (Load-J 'tgw-attachments.json').TransitGatewayAttachments
$vpn = (Load-J 'vpn.json').VpnConnections
$vgws = (Load-J 'vgws.json').VpnGateways
$cgws = (Load-J 'cgws.json').CustomerGateways
$peer = (Load-J 'peering.json').VpcPeeringConnections
$fl = (Load-J 'flowlogs.json').FlowLogs
$elbv2 = (Load-J 'elbv2.json').LoadBalancers
$elb = (Load-J 'elb-classic.json')
$cvpn = (Load-J 'clientvpn.json')
$res = (Load-J 'resolver.json')
$dx = (Load-J 'dx-vifs.json')
$nfw = (Load-J 'nfw.json')
$ga = (Load-J 'ga.json')
$lat = (Load-J 'lattice.json')

function TagName($tags) {
  if (-not $tags) { return '' }
  $t = $tags | Where-Object { $_.Key -eq 'Name' } | Select-Object -First 1
  if ($t) { return $t.Value } else { return '' }
}

$sum = [ordered]@{}
$sum.vpc_count = $vpcs.Count
$sum.vpcs = @($vpcs | ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ id=$_.VpcId; cidr=$_.CidrBlock; isDefault=$_.IsDefault; name=(TagName $_.Tags); state=$_.State } })
$sum.subnet_count = $subnets.Count
$sum.nat_count = $nats.Count
$sum.nats = @($nats | ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ id=$_.NatGatewayId; vpc=$_.VpcId; subnet=$_.SubnetId; state=$_.State; type=$_.ConnectivityType; name=(TagName $_.Tags); eips=@($_.NatGatewayAddresses | ForEach-Object { $_.PublicIp }) } })
$sum.eip_count = $eips.Count
$sum.eips_unassociated = @($eips | Where-Object { -not $_.AssociationId } | ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ alloc=$_.AllocationId; ip=$_.PublicIp; domain=$_.Domain; name=(TagName $_.Tags) } })
$sum.eips_associated_count = @($eips | Where-Object { $_.AssociationId }).Count
$sum.eips_associated = @($eips | Where-Object { $_.AssociationId } | ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ alloc=$_.AllocationId; ip=$_.PublicIp; assoc=$_.AssociationId; instance=$_.InstanceId; eni=$_.NetworkInterfaceId; name=(TagName $_.Tags) } })
$sum.endpoint_count = $eps.Count
$sum.endpoints_by_type = @{}
$eps | Group-Object VpcEndpointType | ForEach-Object { $sum.endpoints_by_type[$_.Name] = $_.Count }
$sum.endpoints = @($eps | ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ id=$_.VpcEndpointId; type=$_.VpcEndpointType; service=$_.ServiceName; vpc=$_.VpcId; state=$_.State; name=(TagName $_.Tags); subnets=@($_.SubnetIds) } })
$sum.eni_count = $enis.Count
$sum.enis_available = @($enis | Where-Object { $_.Status -eq 'available' } | ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ id=$_.NetworkInterfaceId; desc=$_.Description; vpc=$_.VpcId; subnet=$_.SubnetId; public=$_.Association.PublicIp } })
$sum.igw_count = $igws.Count
$sum.tgw_count = $tgws.Count
$sum.tgws = @($tgws | ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ id=$_.TransitGatewayId; state=$_.State; name=(TagName $_.Tags) } })
$sum.tgw_attachment_count = $tgwa.Count
$sum.tgw_attachments = @($tgwa | ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ id=$_.TransitGatewayAttachmentId; tgw=$_.TransitGatewayId; type=$_.ResourceType; resource=$_.ResourceId; vpc=$_.VpcId; state=$_.State; name=(TagName $_.Tags) } })
$sum.vpn_count = $vpn.Count
$sum.vpns = @($vpn | ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ id=$_.VpnConnectionId; state=$_.State; type=$_.Type; vgw=$_.VpnGatewayId; tgw=$_.TransitGatewayId; name=(TagName $_.Tags) } })
$sum.vgw_count = $vgws.Count
$sum.vgws = @($vgws | ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ id=$_.VpnGatewayId; state=$_.State; name=(TagName $_.Tags); attachments=@($_.VpcAttachments) } })
$sum.cgw_count = $cgws.Count
$sum.cgws = @($cgws | ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ id=$_.CustomerGatewayId; state=$_.State; ip=$_.IpAddress; name=(TagName $_.Tags) } })
$sum.peering_count = $peer.Count
$sum.peerings = @($peer | ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ id=$_.VpcPeeringConnectionId; status=$_.Status.Code; requester=$_.RequesterVpcInfo.VpcId; accepter=$_.AccepterVpcInfo.VpcId; name=(TagName $_.Tags) } })
$sum.flowlog_count = $fl.Count
$sum.flowlogs = @($fl | ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ id=$_.FlowLogId; resource=$_.ResourceId; dest=$_.LogDestinationType; destArn=$_.LogDestination; status=$_.FlowLogStatus } })
$sum.elbv2_count = $elbv2.Count
$sum.elbs = @($elbv2 | ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ arn=$_.LoadBalancerArn; name=$_.LoadBalancerName; type=$_.Type; scheme=$_.Scheme; vpc=$_.VpcId; state=$_.State.Code; azs=@($_.AvailabilityZones.ZoneName) } })
$sum.elb_classic = $elb
$sum.clientvpn = $cvpn
$sum.resolver = $res
$sum.dx = $dx
$sum.nfw = $nfw
$sum.ga = $ga
$sum.lattice = $lat

$sum | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | Set-Content -Encoding utf8 (Join-Path $dir 'summary.json')
Write-Output "summary written"
Write-Output "vpcs=$($sum.vpc_count) nats=$($sum.nat_count) eips=$($sum.eip_count) unassoc_eips=$($sum.eips_unassociated.Count) endpoints=$($sum.endpoint_count) enis=$($sum.eni_count) avail_enis=$($sum.enis_available.Count) tgws=$($sum.tgw_count) tgw_att=$($sum.tgw_attachment_count) vpn=$($sum.vpn_count) elbs=$($sum.elbv2_count) peer=$($sum.peering_count) flowlogs=$($sum.flowlog_count)"

$dir = "$env:TEMP\netaws-audit"
# ELB listeners + target groups + health for each LB
$elbs = (Get-Content (Join-Path $dir 'elbv2.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).LoadBalancers
$elbInfo = @()
foreach ($lb in $elbs) {
  $arn = $lb.LoadBalancerArn
  $name = $lb.LoadBalancerName
  $tgs = aws elbv2 describe-target-groups --load-balancer-arn $arn --profile netaws --region us-west-2 --output json 2>$null | ConvertFrom-Json
  $tgSummaries = @()
  foreach ($tg in $tgs.TargetGroups) {
    $health = aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn $tg.TargetGroupArn --profile netaws --region us-west-2 --output json 2>$null | ConvertFrom-Json
    $states = @($health.TargetHealthDescriptions | ForEach-Object { $_.TargetHealth.State })
    $tgSummaries += [ordered]@{
      name = $tg.TargetGroupName
      proto = $tg.Protocol
      port = $tg.Port
      targets = @($health.TargetHealthDescriptions).Count
      healthy = @($states | Where-Object { $_ -eq 'healthy' }).Count
      unused = @($states | Where-Object { $_ -eq 'unused' }).Count
      unhealthy = @($states | Where-Object { $_ -eq 'unhealthy' }).Count
      draining = @($states | Where-Object { $_ -eq 'draining' }).Count
    }
  }
  $listeners = aws elbv2 describe-listeners --load-balancer-arn $arn --profile netaws --region us-west-2 --output json 2>$null | ConvertFrom-Json
  $elbInfo += [ordered]@{
    name = $name
    type = $lb.Type
    scheme = $lb.Scheme
    vpc = $lb.VpcId
    state = $lb.State.Code
    listener_count = @($listeners.Listeners).Count
    target_groups = $tgSummaries
    total_targets = ($tgSummaries | Measure-Object -Property targets -Sum).Sum
    total_healthy = ($tgSummaries | Measure-Object -Property healthy -Sum).Sum
  }
}
$elbInfo | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | Set-Content -Encoding utf8 (Join-Path $dir 'elb-health.json')
$idle = @($elbInfo | Where-Object { $_.total_targets -eq 0 -or $_.total_healthy -eq 0 })
Write-Output "elbs=$($elbInfo.Count) idle_or_no_healthy=$($idle.Count)"
$idle | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ("IDLE {0} type={1} scheme={2} targets={3} healthy={4} listeners={5}" -f $_.name, $_.type, $_.scheme, $_.total_targets, $_.total_healthy, $_.listener_count) }

$dir = "$env:TEMP\netaws-audit"
# raw NAT metric datapoints, 1-day period
$end = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss')
$start = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().AddDays(-14).ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss')
Write-Output "window $start to $end"
foreach ($n in @('nat-0cd0639d57d3d3e1e','nat-0bd6f7ebc8877fe8f','nat-0948491dddfeecf6f','nat-0929d954c03524476')) {
  Write-Output "==== $n BytesOutToDestination ===="
  aws cloudwatch get-metric-statistics --namespace AWS/NATGateway --metric-name BytesOutToDestination --dimensions Name=NatGatewayId,Value=$n --start-time $start --end-time $end --period 86400 --statistics Sum --profile netaws --region us-west-2 --output json
}
# copy elb health if present
if (Test-Path "$dir\elb-health.json") { Write-Output "elb-health exists"; (Get-Item "$dir\elb-health.json").Length }

$dir = "$env:TEMP\netaws-audit"
# Parse unfiltered CE for network-ish usage types
$ce = Get-Content "$dir\ce-raw.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$rows = @()
foreach ($r in $ce.ResultsByTime) {
  foreach ($g in $r.Groups) {
    $key = $g.Keys[0]
    $amt = [double]$g.Metrics.UnblendedCost.Amount
    if ($amt -le 0) { continue }
    if ($key -match 'NatGateway|PublicIPv4|VpcEndpoint|TransitGateway|LoadBalancer|LCU|DataTransfer|VPN|ClientVPN|Resolver|IdleAddress|InUseAddress|NatGateway-Hours|NatGateway-Bytes|USE1-Nat|USW2-Nat|USW2-PublicIPv4|USW2-VpcEndpoint|USW2-TransitGateway|USW2-LoadBalancer|USW2-VPN') {
      $rows += [pscustomobject]@{ usage=$key; cost=[math]::Round($amt,2); start=$r.TimePeriod.Start }
    }
  }
}
$rows | Sort-Object cost -Descending | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String
Write-Output "---- totals ----"
$natH = ($rows | Where-Object { $_.usage -match 'NatGateway-Hours' } | Measure-Object cost -Sum).Sum
$natB = ($rows | Where-Object { $_.usage -match 'NatGateway-Bytes' } | Measure-Object cost -Sum).Sum
$ipv4 = ($rows | Where-Object { $_.usage -match 'PublicIPv4' } | Measure-Object cost -Sum).Sum
$vpce = ($rows | Where-Object { $_.usage -match 'VpcEndpoint' } | Measure-Object cost -Sum).Sum
$tgw = ($rows | Where-Object { $_.usage -match 'TransitGateway' } | Measure-Object cost -Sum).Sum
$elb = ($rows | Where-Object { $_.usage -match 'LoadBalancer|LCU' } | Measure-Object cost -Sum).Sum
Write-Output "NatHours=$natH NatBytes=$natB PublicIPv4=$ipv4 Vpce=$vpce Tgw=$tgw Elb=$elb"

# Confirm Stage NAT has zero routes
$stageRoutes = Get-Content "$dir\nat-routes.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
Write-Output "---- all NAT route targets ----"
$stageRoutes | ForEach-Object { if ($_.nat) { "$($_.nat) $($_.name) $($_.vpc)" } else { $_.ToString() } }

# leftover ENI categories
$sum = Get-Content "$dir\summary.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$avail = $sum.enis_available
$lambda = @($avail | Where-Object { $_.desc -like 'AWS Lambda*' }).Count
$iot = @($avail | Where-Object { $_.desc -like '*DO NOT DELETE*' }).Count
$leftover = @($avail | Where-Object { $_.desc -notlike 'AWS Lambda*' -and $_.desc -notlike '*DO NOT DELETE*' })
Write-Output "available_enis=$($avail.Count) lambda=$lambda iot=$iot other=$($leftover.Count)"
$leftover | ForEach-Object { "$($_.id) $($_.public) $($_.desc)" }
